business: Passion4Growth: done-for-you B2B cold outreach for CEE companies, run by the P4G outreach skill pack (24 skills, Claude + Hermes)
target: Owners and commercial directors of B2B companies in Bulgaria and CEE (wholesale, manufacturing and export, logistics, B2B services, SaaS) with roughly EUR 1-50M revenue, who get most new customers from referrals and trade fairs
where: Bulgaria, Romania, Greece and the wider CEE region

segments.name: Owner of a wholesaler or distributor (EUR 2-10M revenue)
Commercial director at a manufacturer or exporter (EUR 10-50M revenue)
Founder of a logistics, 3PL or B2B services firm
Founder of a SaaS or IT services company selling into CEE and DACH

behaviours.name: Burned by an agency before
behaviours.how: Paid a lead-gen or marketing agency that delivered little; now wants proof before paying.

behaviours.name: Relationship seller
behaviours.how: Wins business through referrals, fairs and personal calls; doubts cold messages work in the industry.

behaviours.name: Numbers-first
behaviours.how: Asks for cost per meeting and payback before anything else.

behaviours.name: DIY tinkerer
behaviours.how: Has tried Apollo, Lemlist or a freelancer in-house and thinks it can be done cheaper.

behaviours.name: Growth-hungry, entering a new market
behaviours.how: Has a concrete plan to enter a new country and needs meetings there fast.

behaviours.name: Reputation and GDPR cautious
behaviours.how: Worries that cold outreach makes the company look spammy or breaks the law.

behaviours.name: Slow committee decider
behaviours.how: Needs a partner or board to sign off on any new recurring spend.

objections: I paid an agency before and got zero meetings
EUR 1,500 a month for three months with no guaranteed meetings?
Cold email does not work in our industry; our buyers are relationship people
Will this hurt our reputation or get us into GDPR trouble?
My team has no time for approvals, gates and sending customer lists
We could just buy Apollo and do it ourselves
Do they actually understand our niche?
habits: you get three or four cold LinkedIn pitches a week from agencies
you exhibit at one or two trade fairs a year
your sales team is two or three people who mostly look after existing accounts
you approve every spend over EUR 1,000 yourself
you plan to enter a new country next year
last quarter two of your bigger customers cut their orders
